i.norm: Verifies that NYSIIS encodes a mixed-content string (special characters, digits, spaces, and letters) by stripping non-alphabetic characters and applying phonetic rules to the remaining letters, producing a 6-character strict-mode result. Input "@A9Q mhK(EVj%r" strips to "AQMHKEVJR", then NYSIIS rules collapse it to "AGNCAF".
